segments.speaker: You
segments.text: The permission guide needs an update before the demo, but I cannot take it on.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Maybe Speaker 2 could update it, if they have time. That is a suggestion, not an assignment.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I need to check my workload before I can say yes. Please do not list me as the owner.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: Understood. The guide is unassigned and we have not set a deadline. I will ask the team about ownership tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: I can commit to reviewing the guide after someone writes it. I am not committing to writing it.

points.text: The permission guide remains unassigned, without a deadline.
points.speaker: You

points.text: You will ask the team about ownership tomorrow.
points.speaker: You

points.text: Speaker 1 committed to reviewing, not writing, the guide.

Did Speaker 2 accept the suggested assignment?
questions.answer: No. Speaker 2 explicitly did not accept it.
